video.decoding_capability: Live view 4 channels of 720p or 2 channels of 1080p via HDMI or VGA output

features: Records up to 16 channels of 720p (1280x720) or 8 channels of 1080p (1920x1080)
Video compression: H.264 baseline, main or high profile; audio G.711 (u-law and a-law), recorded in sync with video
Recording modes: continuous, schedule, event triggered or manual
Motion detection with up to 16 target areas; search by time and date or motion
Supports Grandstream GXV36xx cameras, GXV35xx encoders/decoders and third-party ONVIF cameras; ONVIF 2.2
notes: Remote live view: datasheet gives up to 16 channels via HTTP/HTTPS, user manual gives up to 24 cameras.
Power supply: datasheet gives output 12V/2A 36W, user manual gives 12V/5A 60W; both give input 100~240V 50/60Hz. Power supply rating left out.
Datasheet marks third-party ONVIF camera support as pending.
